Health care workers have sacrificed so much to ensure our health and safety.

As we continue battling the pandemic, mental health services are vital to maintaining the wellbeing of those on the frontlines.

Grateful that #ARP funds are promoting #mentalhealth and wellness.
A great day in #LA02 celebrating Algiers Friendship Day and visiting a fabulous health and wellness fair at Family Center of Hope. https://t.co/cq8il6Aa79

Unacceptable.

Let’s build a better world where Black men and women can withdraw money from their accounts, sleep in their homes, drive a car and simply exist without fear of wrongful detainment or police violence.

It’s not too much to ask. https://t.co/yvqfQMkGvP

Parks like Woldenberg Park are centerpoints of our community, and have huge environmental, cultural, and economic value.
 
So proud to have secured $3M to restore and reinvigorate this 30-year-old park, allowing it to be a place of refuge, exercise & joy for generations to come. https://t.co/uqmoWAlwMj
As an animal lover, I couldn’t sleep on #NationalPetDay! https://t.co/zfDOqWqjQM

As we fight to tackle climate change and transition to a clean energy future, we must also prioritize the wellness and mental health of the next generation who are in the fight of their lives against the #ClimateCrisis. https://t.co/KoXRtAZadv

The New Orleans Mental Health Collaborative has received $1.9 million from @samhsagov to improve mental health services for young people in the city. Mental health and wellness are equally as important as physical health and wellness. https://t.co/hPtnFRCpAX
Healthy challenge! Get out, get some sun, exercise and excitement! TC https://t.co/Rh51jQqIat

Not every wound from a traumatic event is visible. On #PTSDAwarenessDay we can take the time to educate ourselves and spread information about treatment options. To our veterans and anyone else who suffers from PTSD, you are not alone. #MentalHealthMatters https://t.co/JwBKRLOxEz

With today’s advancements, care, and treatment, people with #HIV live long and fulfilling lives. @HHSgov has granted $1,076,450 to provide family-centered care to low income women, infants, children, and youth with HIV in #LA02. @LADeptHealth https://t.co/8pVmxkSOK7

I had the pleasure of hosting the @XULA1925 Community Health & Wellness Festival with #RepDelishaBoyd. The event brought providers directly to #LA02 students, local seniors, and community members in need of medical or mental support. “Our Health is Our Wealth!” #SparkChange https://t.co/Fuqo1ng68C

It is crucial to provide #MentalHealth care and support to those struggling with substance abuse. @odysseyhousela has received $200,000 that I helped secure from @HHSGov to support substance abuse treatment, prevention and mental health needs. https://t.co/PcZ3CcLZ24
.@SteveScalise will survive this cancer diagnosis like he has conquered all other health challenges thrown in his path. He and his family are in my prayers.

The health of our community is important. @HHSgov has granted $888,000 to @LADeptHealth for the #SPAN2023 Program. This will assist in implementing nutrition & physical activity strategies that address health disparities in communities like #LA02, especially for our youth. https://t.co/UnKwpzNrgu

Today is #NationalDepressionScreeningDay. Depression is one of the most common mental health disorders and it is important to get check ups for our minds just as we would for our bodies. If you have been experiencing symptoms, please talk to your health care provider. @NAMILouisiana @LADeptHealth

We have made amazing advancements in the treatment of HIV & AIDS, but it continues to disproportionately impact the #Latinx community. As a member of the @EqualityCaucus, I’m committed to raising awareness and fighting for equity in care. https://t.co/UaSZj5HS8d

It’s been 2 years since @hospitals4kids, @AmerAcadPeds, & @AACAP declared #KidsMentalHealth a national emergency. This crisis is on-going and I will continue to fight for accessible treatment and support for our youth with legislation like my #MentalHealthWorkforceAct. https://t.co/uIcN10twdN
On National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, I’m working to end the stigma and increase access to treatment and preventative care so that we can #StopHIVTogether. #NBHAAD https://t.co/aK4yMg7ond
I’m wearing my turquoise ribbon today to raise awareness for #LungCancer. I’m working with the @LungAssociation for better prevention, early detection, and treatment. https://t.co/vcHmLyMUwS

It was wonderful to speak at the @AmCollegeGastro #ACGAdvocacyDay2024. 
Colorectal cancer is the 4th most common in the country, so it’s vitally important that we ensure everyone has equitable access to prevention and treatment. https://t.co/aFiNjbFxCa

As we begin #MentalHealthAwareness Month I will continue fighting to end the stigma surrounding seeking treatment and champion legislation like my #MentalHealthWorkforceAct that addresses gaps in mental health care. 
Please remember that you are never alone. If you are ever experiencing a mental health crisis, call 988 for 24/7 support.

We must protect our children’s health, both physical and mental. The #ThriveKids Student Wellness Program by @CHNOLA received a $10 million expansion to support health care for students, made possible by federal funding from the #AmericanRescuePlan. Let’s keep working for the well-being of our youth.
https://t.co/ARs3qBUpCg

Last week, during #ALC53, I hosted a panel titled 'We Are One! Strength in Unity.' The panelists discussed the importance of supporting #MentalHealth in the Black community, especially on #HBCU campuses. Together, we can end the stigma surrounding mental health treatment. #ALC53Recap
